about: Pre-recorded Arabic introduction made with Canva AI Voice, for Al Mulhim (the only assistant persona). It is a recording of a fixed welcome, never live speech, and plays only when the person presses Play. Canva downloads AI Voice only inside an MP4 video; add the clip with: backend\.venv\Scripts\python.exe tools\import_canva_intro.py --persona mulhim --input <the MP4> --voice "<voice name in Canva>". The tool copies the audio track out without re-encoding, refuses silent or broken files, and fills in 'src', 'transcript' and 'provenance' here. While 'src' is null the introduction is not offered.
